reason: $147 a month is three or four times what other Instagram DM tools charge, and I only do cold outreach when my pipeline is thin. Most of my leads come from posting and comment-to-DM, and I track them in a Google Sheet that already works.
objection: $147 a month for something I'd use part of the time, with no customer results published and a card up front. If it bills on day 4 the payment is final, and I'm not betting that on a product with 7 founding customers.
would_change_my_mind: A price near $50 to $60 a month, or real results from people in my spot, like reply and booking numbers from SDRs or agency owners. A trial that doesn't need a card would also help.
